relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: Recent studies indicate that the aforementioned negative consequences are partially influenced by the stimulation of NLRs, specifically the NLRP3 inflammasome, and the subsequent assembly of the inflammasome.

key_findings: Review: NLRP3 inflammasome activation contributes to neuroinflammation underlying opioid-induced hyperalgesia and tolerance.
